subject: Add DAG+distill ON config to combined bench; compare raw-DAG vs DAG+distill on featurebench
description:
Increment on the combined ON-vs-OFF bench (task e90ac60e-.../1). Motivated by note:note-mqjobfmve2n: new LoCoMo result shows distill 34% / combined 36% >> raw-notes our-way 10%, so the CANDIDATE production retrieval is DAG + distilled. Add a DAG+distill ON config: before seeding the probe's KB note(s), distill them into atomic facts via bench/agent-memory/distill.py (the atomic-fact extractor that writes via the post_note path), then retrieve via the SAME production gate-first path (search_knowledge gated:true + get_dependency_summaries). Make distill a TOGGLE so the ON arm runs BOTH raw-DAG (current production) and DAG+distill (candidate). Run the full combined bench on featurebench under both ON configs; report the per-category accuracy + token delta.

PURPOSE / why this gates production: featurebench raw-DAG 'on' already scores 76.7% (LLM-judge rescore) vs LoCoMo's 10%, so the LoCoMo distill win may NOT transfer to engineering memory. This MEASURES whether distill actually helps on featurebench BEFORE distillation is promoted into the production daemon. If distill helps -> promote to daemon (separate follow-on); if not -> production stays raw-DAG. Honesty bar (no gold/evidence leak), OFF-capped-at-ON-spend, and LLM-judge grading unchanged. Reuse distill.py; do not reinvent. Commit to the orch/attempt branch before complete_task.

summary: Added --on-config raw-dag|dag-distill toggle to bench/zonoid_bench/combined_bench.py. dag-distill mode: distills each problem's gold text into atomic facts via distill.py (_claude_p+_parse_facts+_DISTILL_PROMPT), seeds into an isolated per-problem workspace, rebinds daemon, runs same production canonical_wiring, restores workspace. raw-dag=current behavior unchanged. Honesty bar unchanged. Smoke: import OK, score-only synthetic OK, distill_note_text extracts 8 facts from real note, seed_distilled_notes seeds+retrieves (score=0.708) in isolated workspace. Commit: 0548213 on orch/attempt/e90ac60e-72a4-49e3-b6c4-cdcdc2219c2f-3. open_risks: (1) per-problem LLM distill call adds ~90s latency per problem; (2) isolated workspace rebind is not thread-safe (bench is single-threaded so no race); (3) dag-distill seeds only the gold note - multi-evidence problems with multiple seeded notes (e.g. partial notes) are not yet handled.

summary: Added --on-config raw-dag|dag-distill toggle to combined_bench.py. dag-distill: (1) reads source CODE from evidence field (e.g. daemon.js:206-211) via _read_source_lines, (2) distills to atomic facts via _SOURCE_DISTILL_PROMPT+_parse_distill_facts+claude_p, (3) seeds into a dedicated distill workspace via build_distill_workspace (ALL problems seeded ONCE before run loop), (4) workspace bound ONCE at run start, restored on exit, (5) retrieves via same arms.run_canonical_wiring production path. Gold never read in any distill/seed/retrieve step. Workspace isolation: one bind per run (not per-problem). Smoke (--limit 2): 17 fact notes seeded from daemon.js source, workspace bound once, ON arm retrieved distill-source note keys (not gold), gold never in ON_predicted, raw-dag still yields MEM-WIN. Commit 3105e94 on orch/attempt/e90ac60e-72a4-49e3-b6c4-cdcdc2219c2f-3. open_risks: (1) distill LLM call adds ~60-90s latency per problem in ingest phase; (2) atomic facts from source are more granular than mined raw notes — retrieval cosine gap may be wider, producing more judge_idle; (3) --distill-workspace flag allows reusing pre-built distill KB to skip re-ingest.
